note: The calibration records (the release fit set) that `python -m calibration.tmopt_ext record` prepares, as the paper-eval runs had them: per model the revision, the fit set's documents and token hashes, and a digest of every quantized matrix's source sha256. The record file itself holds a local snapshot path, so its own sha256 is not portable; experiments.paper_1k.setup compares these fields.
